title: v5.4.3 — Real Soft-Lock Fix & Desktop Layout Reset
message: The actual cause of the soft-lock bug found and removed: when a popup opened, the body was getting position:fixed pinned to the top of the viewport — if cleanup ever misfired, the page stayed pinned forever and you could only see the first screenful of content. Now using a much safer html-only overflow:hidden lock that can't break the layout. A continuous janitor runs every 2 seconds — if a scroll-lock is stuck while no overlay is open, it clears it automatically. Should never need to wipe app data again. Desktop layout reset: removed the 540px-wide centered mobile-style frame entirely. Page now flows naturally at full width like a regular site. For larger screens, the entire UI scales up proportionally (1.15× at 900px+, 1.25× at 1280px+, 1.35× at 1600px+) so buttons stay comfortable to click without breaking the layout.
